hooks.command: payload=$(cat); case "$payload" in *"git commit"*) DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -x "$DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" ]; then PY="$DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; elif [ -x "$DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="$DIR/.venv/bin/python"; else PY=python3; fi; printf '%s' "$payload" | "$PY" "$DIR/.claude/hooks/pre_bash.py";; esac

DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -x "$DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" ]; then PY="$DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; elif [ -x "$DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="$DIR/.venv/bin/python"; else PY=python3; fi; "$PY" "$DIR/.claude/hooks/post_edit.py"
